name: scene-text-gt-oracle-no-filters-v1

localization.contour_extraction: retain the separately declared diagnostic method

rationale: User-requested diagnostic: GT masks already identify text; native-128 Amin=150 removed 1171 of 2204 Total-Text GT-v4 contours, including 1086 that would match a GT word at IoU>=0.5. The top-10 cap removed only 3. Removing both isolates mask-resolution and OCR effects.
paper_difference: Algorithm 1 specifies area filtering and a maximum of 10 blocks; this policy is not a paper reproduction claim.
